items.headline: Chainflip Suspects Key Theft in $12.6M $FLIP Vault Hack
items.summary: Chainflip's first report points to validly signed transfers outside the protocol, with key theft suspected but unconfirmed. Services remain paused as $FLIP holders await answers.

items.headline: $S Supply Shock: Sonic Reports 4.7B Tokens, 48% Above Launch
items.summary: Sonic disclosed 4.70 billion $S, 48% above its launch figure, with a 91.7M token burn planned. The historical $FTM supply mismatch is still under investigation.

items.headline: Tydro TVL Quadruples as $USDe Lending Booms
items.summary: DefiLlama data shows Tydro's TVL quadrupled by Nov. 22 as $USDe balances surged and outstanding loans hit $258.6M, though TVL sits below its Nov. 20 peak.

items.headline: $JTO Plan Puts Foundation First for New Network Fees
items.summary: Jito's JIP-40 ties DAO sharing of new revenues to a $20M annual threshold while preserving existing DAO income and $JTO buybacks. A big governance shift for Solana MEV.

items.headline: $PUMP to End External Wallet Login on Nov. 30
items.summary: Pump.fun is dropping external wallet logins, pushing a web import flow that asks for private keys. $PUMP users can instead create a new wallet and transfer funds.
